parameters.query:
SELECT day_of_week, start_time, end_time
FROM doctor_schedule_rules
WHERE clinic_id = $1::uuid
  AND doctor_id = $2::uuid
  AND day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM $3::date)
  AND rule_type = 'weekly'
  AND is_available = true
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY start_time ASC;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($("Prepare Search Window").item.json.clinic_id || ""), String($("Prepare Search Window").item.json.doctor_id || ""), String($("Prepare Search Window").item.json.requested_date || "")] }}
